# Whisper Almanac

> Whispered ASMR for sleep on YouTube (@whisperalmanac): guided meditations built on Neville Goddard's techniques, money affirmations, and slow, sleepy history and science. Every video is narrated by an AI copy of the creator's own whispering voice and is marked as altered content on YouTube. A Spry Labs channel.

- [Home](https://whisperalmanac.com/): what the channel is and where to watch it
- [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@whisperalmanac): every video
- [About](https://whisperalmanac.com/about/): who makes the channel, how each video is voiced, and how AI use is disclosed
- [Privacy policy](https://whisperalmanac.com/privacy/): the website and the Whisper Almanac Uploader
